name: talgent
description: Authoritative distribution of first-party Talgent Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: talgent-runtime
plugins.description: Default Talgent Work runtime context: activates a Work executor agent, Intent workspace guidance, and lightweight plugin hook telemetry.

plugins.name: talgent
plugins.description: Talgent's core plugin for its Agents: the product context, the Personal Work role and the Skills every Work acts through.

plugins.name: talgent-api
plugins.description: Talgent's public API for Agents that call it directly: publishing a Work's Artifacts and reading its owner's Personal Library.

plugins.name: talgent-orchestra
plugins.description: Talgent Orchestra's runtime for its Agents, beside the core runtime plugin: the Project context, one role per Project run mode (Work Agent, PM Coordinator, Alignment) and the project Skills they act through.
